mapper.select: SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.users.selectUsers */ USER_ID as userId, NAME as name, POSITION as position, EMAIL as email, PHONE as phone, ACCOUNT_ID as accountId, ACCOUNT_PWD as accountPwd, IMAGE as image, IS_DELETED as isDeleted FROM USERS WHERE ACCOUNT_ID = #{accountId}

SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.users.selectListCountUsers */ COUNT(*) totcnt FROM USERS WHERE 1=1
AND NAME like '%${scName}%'

SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.users.selectUsersMapping */ U.USER_ID AS userId, U.NAME AS name, P.PJT_ID AS pjtId, P.PJT_NAME AS pjtName, PUG.GRP_ID AS grpId, G.GRP_NAME AS grpName FROM USERS U JOIN PROJECT_USER_GROUP PUG ON U.USER_ID = PUG.USER_ID JOIN PJT P ON PUG.PJT_ID = P.PJT_ID JOIN GROUPS G ON PUG.GRP_ID = G.GRP_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND U.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY userId, pjtId, grpId
mapper.update: UPDATE USERS /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.users.resetPwd */ SET ACCOUNT_PWD = "1234" WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
